brief:
Israeli authorities are intensifying media blackouts on Al-Aqsa Mosque during the extended Jewish holiday season, according to Shehab Wire. The systematic information suppression coincides with what Palestinians describe as escalating efforts to Judaize the sacred site, making it increasingly difficult for Palestinians to document and track groups of settlers entering the compound.

The restrictions on coverage represent part of a broader policy coordinating military control of the mosque with efforts to limit public documentation of activities there, the wire reported.

title: Israeli occupation restricts reporting on Al-Aqsa desecrations
